body:
This PR pins the shared depot to one `versions/<n>` directory for the whole build. The `atmos-depot` pipeline swaps `climaatmos-ci/depot/shared` to a new version every day at 11:00 UTC, so steps that started before the swap had loaded part of their packages from the old version and then found only the new version's caches ([error](https://buildkite.com/clima/climaatmos-ci/builds/32600#01a1cf72-7a38-4e26-ac0a-566edbf18917)). Build 32600 lost 50 of 106 steps this way.

### Changes
- `decide_pipeline.sh`: resolve `shared` once and export `SHARED_DEPOT`, which `pipeline upload` bakes into every step
- `full_pipeline.yml`: use `${SHARED_DEPOT}` in `JULIA_DEPOT_PATH` instead of the symlink

The depot build keeps three versions, so a pinned path stays valid for three days. The two short steps in `pipeline.yml` keep using the symlink.

This PR was generated by an LLM.
title: Pin the shared depot to one version for the whole build
